method.limits: All dates reused. Full-period winners explicitly hindsight. No unseen validation. Features use candles closed by confirmation. ATR14 here is simple mean TR, not Wilder. Relative volume compares with 19 prior candles; SMA20 includes confirmation. Missing indicator context rejects relevant filters. Dollar results exclude uncertain/open outcomes and costs except labeled sensitivity. Fixed risk; no compounding or daily/concurrent-risk/margin simulation. DD is resolved exit-bar cash only, excludes floating risk. Period grouping uses signal UTC date. Historical reference reconstruction inherited from archived study.
method.costs: Assumed 100oz contract and .01 lot min/step, second-only fallback, rounded lots downward, illustrative round-trip price costs .20/.50 plus $7/lot. Not broker executions. No-size includes invalid geometry.
method.selection: Highest training net minus half realized drawdown, >=40 closed, >=12 closed in each training month, >=50% win rate. Train Aug-Sep for Oct; train Aug-Oct for Nov. Exploratory retrospective walk-forward.
method.managementReview: Prior 101-management-variant study: max historical result at 1.5R/75% close-second+first-BE was $2716.96 over Aug3-Nov18, versus $2666.51 hold1.25R. Previously selected management rule earned $1503.92 in later Oct-Nov versus $1729.30 hold. This study therefore focuses on setup filters and asymmetric exits rather than claiming a management upgrade.
